description: This source file implements a report in the ERPNext system that displays item stock and pricing details, including item codes, names, warehouses, available stock, and prices from different price lists. It contains functions to generate report columns, fetch and process data, including price mappings, and handle filters for querying item prices and stock quantities.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point for the report; retrieves columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns()
methods.description: Defines and returns the list of columns to display in the report.

methods.name: get_data(filters, columns)
methods.description: Fetches and returns the processed data for the report based on filters and columns.

methods.name: get_item_price_qty_data(filters)
methods.description: Retrieves item stock quantities and related details, including prices, applying optional filters.

methods.name: get_price_map(price_list_names, buying=0, selling=0)
methods.description: Builds a mapping from item price list names to their respective rates and price list identifiers for buying or selling prices.
